name: Public Goods & Free Riding: The Las Acacias Court
description: Run the council of a 38-household block deciding how to fund six community projects. Compare voluntary contribution, threshold pledge, vote-and-tax, and club-good across provision, equity, and trust — and feel why every government in history has eventually used coercion for public goods.
